profile_text.body:
World Labs is a for-profit startup founded in 2024 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. On its own site the company describes itself as a spatial intelligence company, saying it builds frontier models that can perceive, generate, and interact with the 3D world, and that it is working on world models that perceive, generate, reason, and interact with virtual and physical worlds.

The harvested site text does not name any specific product, model, or release, and no products are tracked for the company. The material available describes its stated direction in spatial intelligence and world models rather than any shipped offering.

The company's recorded legal exposure is in California, with a count of 281. No lawsuits or MCP servers are listed for it.
